items.title: Lidl GB's Premium Private-Label Range Exceeds £1bn In Annual Sales
items.summary: Lidl GB has announced that its premium own-label range, Deluxe, has exceeded the £1 billion milestone in annual sales for the first time.

Ringmetall Expands To US Bag-In-Box Market With New Acquisition
items.summary: German packaging group Ringmetall has announced the acquisition of US-based bag-in-box packaging firm Rapak LLC for an undisclosed sum.

items.title: Bruna owner Audax is teetering on the brink of bankruptcy
items.summary: The Dutch retail and media group Audax, owner of the Bruna bookstore chain, is fighting for its survival. Debts running into the millions and a bitter management crisis have left the company in acute financial distress. The court has granted Audax some temporary breathing room.

items.title: French perfume chain Marionnaud becomes a half-sister to April and Di
items.summary: After twenty years under Chinese ownership, the Marionnaud perfume chain is once again in French hands. David Konckier, CEO and majority shareholder of the Bogart cosmetics group (April and Di), is taking over the struggling retailer. He is inheriting 700 stores, but also…

items.title: Coca-Cola FEMSA, OXXO Deliver Almost 10% Revenue Growth In Q3
items.summary: Mexican retail and beverage group FEMSA delivered a 9.8% increase in consolidated revenues for Q3 of its 2026 financial year.

items.title: Nestlé backs women’s sport in major multi-year deal
items.summary: Nestlé Confectionery has become the Official Partner of Everton Women in a multi-year deal that highlights the importance of women's sport as a platform for CPGs looking to engage with families and younger consumers.

items.title: Hershey’s CEO highlights softness in c-store sales
items.summary: Kirk Tanner said during the company’s Q3 earnings call that the convenience channel is a particularly challenging one for the candy maker right now.

items.title: FTC reveals new details on alleged multibillion-dollar Amazon ad scheme
items.summary: The FTC and 22 states released new details in their Amazon ad lawsuit, alleging hidden surcharges that inflated advertisers’ costs by billions.

items.title: ESM’s Retail Wrap – Coop Estonia, Konzum, REWE, Nestlé
items.summary: Coop Estonia backs plea to cut food VAT; Konzum offers new parcel locker service; Shell, REWE extend partnership; Nestlé divests SimplyCook.

items.title: Hush opens first three standalone stores as it moves onto the high street
items.summary: UK-founded womenswear brand Hush has opened its first three standalone stores, as it expands its predominantly online business into physical retail. The retailer has launched locations at Bluewater shopping centre in Kent, Guildford High Street in Surrey and Marlow High Street…

items.title: Morocco Pauses Tomato Exports To African Markets Amid High Prices At Home
items.summary: Morocco paused tomato exports to African markets to ensure steady domestic supply and help lower prices at home.

items.title: Trial vs. loyalty: The retail growth challenge facing emerging brands
items.summary: The difference between a breakout brand and a short-lived retail presence often comes down to repeat purchase, with experts at a recent StartupCPG webinar arguing that emerging brands need separate strategies for trial and loyalty to build lasting retail velocity.

items.summary: The exclusive event will bring together members of the perimeter fresh-food industry for an evening of networking opportunities.
